data.current_description:
Runs syntax, DNS and SMTP checks and returns a deliverability verdict.

Test-mode shortcuts (the local part of the address):
- `bounce@…` → `undeliverable`
- `catchall@…` → `risky`
- `grey@…` → `unknown` / greylisted
- anything else → `deliverable`
data.description_suggestion: Verifies a single email address by running syntax, DNS, and SMTP checks to determine deliverability. Accepts an email address in the request body. Returns a VerificationResult object containing the deliverability verdict and detailed check results. On live keys, this operation charges 1 credit per verification; test keys return fixture results for free. Test-mode shortcuts: `bounce@…` returns `undeliverable`, `catchall@…` returns `risky`, `grey@…` returns `unknown` (greylisted), and other addresses return `deliverable`.
